name.zh: 工程智能体与空间推理

papers.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?

note.en: I co-designed the benchmark, ran model experiments and evaluated the engineering files produced at each stage.
note.zh: 我参与了基准设计、模型实验与评测，逐阶段检查智能体交付的工程文件是否满足任务要求。

papers.authors: Hongcheng Gao*, Hailong Qu*, Yu Lei*, et al.

caption.en: EngiWorld uses tasks such as building-model export and cross-software analysis of a finned plate to evaluate agents in six engineering domains.
caption.zh: EngiWorld 以建筑模型导出和散热板的跨软件分析为例，展示六个工程领域的智能体任务。

papers.zh_title: EngiWorld：前沿智能体能在专业工程环境中交付什么？

papers.title: SpatialWorld: Benchmarking Interactive Spatial Reasoning of Multimodal Agents in Real-World Tasks

note.en: I helped design the benchmark, ran experiments and evaluated how agents navigated and manipulated objects across eight simulated environments.
note.zh: 我参与了基准设计与模型实验，评估智能体在八个仿真环境中通过第一人称观测导航和操作物体的能力。

papers.authors: Hongcheng Gao*, Hailong Qu*, Jingyi Tang, et al.

caption.en: Agents use first-person observations to act in indoor, street and game environments. The benchmark checks their final state and the number of actions taken.
caption.zh: 智能体根据第一人称观测在室内、街道和游戏环境中行动。基准检查任务终态，并对照参考轨迹评估执行步数。

figures.credit: Gao, Qu et al. (2026) · CC BY 4.0

papers.zh_title: SpatialWorld：真实任务中多模态智能体的交互式空间推理基准

papers.title: Predicting power and fatigue loads of yawed large offshore wind turbine based on cross-scale transfer learning

note.en: A model pretrained on 5 MW turbine simulations was transferred to 15 MW turbines. With 40% of the target-domain data, it matched an XGBoost baseline trained on 80%.
note.zh: 将 5 MW 风机仿真数据上预训练的模型迁移至 15 MW 机组，使用 40% 的目标域数据，达到 XGBoost 用 80% 数据时的预测精度。

papers.authors: Hailong Qu, Tianzhen Wei, Guoqing Huang, et al.

caption.en: Six networks are pretrained on 5 MW turbine simulations and fine-tuned on 15 MW data. One predicts power and the other five each predict a fatigue load.
caption.zh: 先用 5 MW 风机仿真数据预训练六个网络，再用 15 MW 风机数据微调全部参数。一个网络预测功率，其余五个分别预测一项疲劳载荷。

caption.en: Predicted and simulated power and fatigue loads for the 15 MW target turbine. Blue points are training cases and red points are test cases.
caption.zh: 15 MW 目标风机的功率与疲劳载荷预测值和仿真值对照。蓝点为训练工况，红点为测试工况。

papers.zh_title: 基于跨尺度迁移学习的偏航大型海上风机功率与疲劳载荷预测

papers.title: A machine learning model based on GAN-ANN data augmentation for predicting the bond strength of FRP-reinforced concrete under high-temperature conditions

note.en: We augmented high-temperature pull-out test data using a GAN, compared six regression models and used SHAP to interpret bond-strength predictions.
note.zh: 用生成对抗网络扩充高温拉拔试验数据，比较六种回归模型，并用 SHAP 解释纤维增强复合材料筋与混凝土的黏结强度预测。

papers.authors: Hailong Qu, Tianyu Hu, Jiting Qu, Woubishet Zewdu Taffese.

caption.en: GAN data augmentation for FRP–concrete bond tests. The generator creates synthetic samples from noise, and the discriminator distinguishes them from experimental records.
caption.zh: FRP 筋与混凝土黏结试验的 GAN 数据增广结构。生成器从噪声生成合成样本，判别器区分合成样本与试验记录。

caption.en: Test-set RMSE and R² for six bond-strength models after adding 30% synthetic data generated using GAN–ANN, KDE or TGAN.
caption.zh: 用 GAN–ANN、核密度估计或 TGAN 增加 30% 合成样本，比较六种黏结强度模型在真实测试集上的 RMSE 与 R²。

papers.zh_title: 基于 GAN–ANN 数据增强的高温下 FRP 筋与混凝土黏结强度预测

papers.title: Prestressed UHPC Beam Flexural Capacity Prediction Improvement with Constraint-Guided Neural Networks

note.en: Geometric, reinforcement and material-strength constraints guide a neural network that predicts the flexural capacity of prestressed ultra-high-performance concrete beams.
note.zh: 将几何关系、配筋与材料强度约束引入神经网络，预测预应力超高性能混凝土梁的抗弯承载力。

papers.venue: International Journal of Bridge Engineering, Management and Research
papers.authors: Hailong Qu, Le Teng, Yanping Zhu, Zhongke Qu, Hantao Wu.

caption.en: The constraint-guided network predicts the flexural capacity of prestressed UHPC beams. Its training loss combines data-fitting error with constraints on cross-sectional geometry, reinforcement ratio, and the relationship between tensile and compressive strength.
caption.zh: 约束引导神经网络预测预应力 UHPC 梁的抗弯承载力。训练损失包含数据拟合误差，以及截面几何、配筋率和混凝土抗拉与抗压强度关系的约束项。

figures.credit: © 2025 Hailong Qu, Le Teng, Yanping Zhu, Zhongke Qu and Hantao Wu · CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

caption.en: Mean relative training and test errors for seven combinations of physical constraints in prestressed UHPC beam capacity prediction.
caption.zh: 七种物理约束组合下，预应力 UHPC 梁抗弯承载力预测的训练与测试平均相对误差。

figures.credit: © 2025 Hailong Qu, Le Teng, Yanping Zhu, Zhongke Qu and Hantao Wu · CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

papers.zh_title: 用约束引导神经网络改进预应力 UHPC 梁抗弯承载力预测

alt.en: Alternating teal and amber vortices form downstream of a cylinder in EngiWorld’s OpenFOAM reference solution.
alt.zh: EngiWorld 的 OpenFOAM 参考流场中，圆柱下游交替出现青色和橙色涡旋。

credit.en: EngiWorld Authors (2026). The cylinder wake was rendered from the public OpenFOAM reference velocity field at Re = 100 and t = 20 s. Teal and amber show opposite signs of vorticity.
credit.zh: EngiWorld 团队（2026）。圆柱尾流图由公开的 OpenFOAM 参考速度场计算绘制，工况为 Re = 100、t = 20 s。青色和橙色表示方向相反的涡量。

description.en: We built 1,301 tasks across 26 professional applications to test whether agents can produce engineering files that meet the task requirements.
description.zh: 在 26 款专业软件中设计 1,301 项任务，检验智能体交付的工程文件能否满足设计要求。

alt.en: Exploded view of SpatialWorld’s two-floor Maze3D level 23. An orange route crosses the upper floor and returns to the goal below. Dashed lines join the stairs.
alt.zh: SpatialWorld 双层迷宫第 23 关的分解视图。橙色参考路线经上层绕行后回到底层终点，虚线连接对应楼梯。

credit.en: SpatialWorld, Hongcheng Gao, Hailong Qu et al. (2026). The two floors of Maze3D Pro level 23 are shown apart. The orange path follows the 18 published reference actions. Dashed lines connect the same stair cells on each floor.
credit.zh: SpatialWorld，Gao、Qu 等（2026）。图中分开展示 Maze3D Pro 第 23 关的两层布局。橙线按公开的 18 条参考动作绘制，虚线连接上下层相同位置的楼梯。

description.en: Across 760 interactive tasks, agents use first-person views to explore unfamiliar environments, navigate and manipulate objects.
description.zh: 760 项交互任务检验智能体能否凭第一人称画面探索陌生环境、导航并操作物体。

institution.en: China University of Mining and Technology
